about.title: About sc-friends
about.disclaimer: Unofficial tool, not affiliated with Cloud Imperium Games / Roberts Space Industries in any way. Provided as-is, use at your own risk — removing a friend stays visible to that person.
about.referral: Made by Warween. If this tool was useful to you and you don't play Star Citizen yet, use my referral code {code} when creating your account — we both get a starting credits (UEC) bonus 🚀
setup.title: How to populate / refresh friends.db
setup.intro: Each step runs a real script. Step 1 opens a real browser: log in normally (2FA included), then click "I'm logged in".
setup.step1.title: Login
setup.step1.desc: Opens Chromium on Spectrum, saves the session to auth.json once logged in.
setup.step2.title: Fetch
setup.step2.desc: Reloads auth.json and fetches the full friends list into friends.json.
setup.step3.title: Import
setup.step3.desc: Loads friends.json into friends.db (upsert: never overwrites decisions already made).
danger.title: ⚠ Real deletion on Spectrum
danger.confirmLabel: Type YES in capitals to enable the button:
footer.text: Decisions are local. Only the red button triggers real calls to Spectrum.
confirmBulk: Mark ALL currently filtered results ({count}) as "{label}"?
dangerDesc: Really removes, on the site, every friend marked "Remove" and not yet applied ({n}). Irreversible on the friend's side. Drives a real browser clicking the Unfriend button, with a pause between each removal.
lastConfirm: Final confirmation: really run the deletion on Spectrum?
